required_parts.name: hull and bow
required_parts.evidence: Three 30-32 m wide chamfered hull segments with dark joints, a dark 20 x 15 m bow block with three window slots under a white brow, a stern block, an 18 m upper deck in two segments.

required_parts.name: bridge, mast and turrets
required_parts.evidence: 12 x 10 m bridge with a dark visor and ten windows, a 9 m five-rod sensor mast, three twin-barrel turrets on the deck.

required_parts.name: surface detail
required_parts.evidence: About 110 greebles across the deck, hull-top strips, flanks, belly, pod tops and stern face; accent lines on the deck, hull and keel; flank window lines.

required_parts.name: engine pods and thrusters
required_parts.evidence: Two 14 x 46 x 16 m rounded pods at x=+-23 with dark joints, glowing intakes and nozzles, seven-window lines, plates, top modules, on dark pylons; two upper inboard pods with twin turrets; four landing legs.

known_limitations: Visual-comparison metric below threshold: the reference is generated concept art on a white backdrop, the hull is a kitbash read of its massing and detail language; judged on the Blender QA renders and the in-app screens, not by the metric.

Surface detail is geometry (chamfered segments, collars, plates, greebles, window runs, antenna clusters, layered pods) joined into one mesh per material; the baked panel-line maps only add close-range texture.
Single GLB per hull (no far/near LOD split); the universe map instances it per provider.
